notes: handle([...]) over 50 byPattern(path, byMethod({...})) handlers (URLPattern per path, tried in order, the library's own composition); each of the 100 routes has its own handler returning one Response made at start-up. byMethod answers a wrong method with its own 405 and an unmatched path gets handle's 404. URLPattern does not percent-decode, so the handler decodes the id with decodeURIComponent.
